items.headline: Accenture forecast takes hit from Iran war, shares tumble over 17% after cutting revenue outlook and announcing $4.18 billion in cybersecurity acquisitions
Accenture stock slumps after fiscal Q3 miss and weaker Q4 revenue outlook tied to Iran conflict; unveils $4.18 billion cybersecurity deals
Accenture shares log worst single-day drop in years after soft revenue forecast amid AI disruption and Middle East conflict
